name: Create a sending subdomain
description: Create a sending subdomain Creates a new sending subdomain or re-enables sending on an existing subdomain that had it disabled. POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/email/sending/subdomains
context:
POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/email/sending/subdomains
Creates a new sending subdomain or re-enables sending on an existing subdomain that had it disabled. If zone-level Email Sending has not been enabled yet, the zone flag is automatically set when the entitlement is present. A leftmost wildcard such as `*.example.com` is accepted only for accounts with wildcard Email Sending enabled. Wildcard senders share the base domain's DKIM signing identity and `cf-bounce. ` return path.
Required: zone_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete a sending subdomain

name: Fix sending subdomain DNS records
description: Fix sending subdomain DNS records Idempotently re-applies the sending DNS records (creates missing records, re-applies the email_routing lock on records whose lock has been cleared). POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/email/sending/subdomains/{subdomain_id}/dns
context:
POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/email/sending/subdomains/{subdomain_id}/dns
Idempotently re-applies the sending DNS records (creates missing records, re-applies the email_routing lock on records whose lock has been cleared). Refuses with a 409 if foreign MX, multiple SPF, multiple DMARC, or multiple DKIM records exist at the relevant DNS names — those require manual cleanup.
Required: subdomain_id (path); zone_id (path)

name: Get sending subdomain DNS status
description: Get sending subdomain DNS status Returns the desired DNS records for a sending subdomain along with a live diff against actual DNS state. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/email/sending/subdomains/{subdomain_id}/dns/status
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/email/sending/subdomains/{subdomain_id}/dns/status
Returns the desired DNS records for a sending subdomain along with a live diff against actual DNS state. Use this to detect missing, unlocked, foreign, or multi-record conflicts before deciding whether to call the fix endpoint. For wildcard sending rows, each call also rechecks the governing organizational-domain DMARC policy and reports policy drift that DNS Fix cannot repair.
Required: subdomain_id (path); zone_id (path)

name: Preview sending subdomain DNS
description: Preview sending subdomain DNS Returns the DNS records that would be created for a sending subdomain, flags which records are missing, and reports any conflicts with existing DNS records. POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/email/sending/subdomains/preview
context:
POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/email/sending/subdomains/preview
Returns the DNS records that would be created for a sending subdomain, flags which records are missing, and reports any conflicts with existing DNS records. This is a read-only dry-run — no records are created or modified. Use before or after creating a subdomain to check DNS status. A leftmost wildcard requires wildcard Email Sending to be enabled for the account and previews base-scoped DKIM and return-path records.
Required: zone_id (path); body (body)

name: Inspect SPF Record
description: Inspect SPF Record Inspects a specific SPF TXT record and returns a parsed tree structure in the spflimit-worker format. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/email/auth/spf/inspect
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/email/auth/spf/inspect
Inspects a specific SPF TXT record and returns a parsed tree structure in the spflimit-worker format. The record ID must be provided via the `id` query parameter. Returns a recursive tree showing: - Parsed components with their qualifiers and types - Nested includes recursively resolved within components - Per-component and total lookup counts - Detailed error information with context
Required: zone_id (path) — Zone identifier.; id (query) — DNS record ID (rec_tag) to inspect
